plan.acceptance: At least 12 valid held-out cases, 3 changed choices, positive total team reward, more team improvements than regressions, no case with extra actor or allied-team deaths, and no changed case rated worse by the broader rubric. This exploratory gate does not approve full-match deployment.
plan.collection: First naturally eligible safe farm/push pair after 120s in each world; retain missing/invalid cases. Freeze training-only model before collecting any held-out outcomes. No retuning.

limits: First-choice 30-second proxy windows only, two fixed drafts, approximate route and basic-attack clear time. No full-match improvement or safety guarantee. No tuning on these held-out outcomes.
